coherence_wS.interpretation: inter-family coda coherence is near chance at all lapse times for separations >= 3 km (and only ~0.15 below 2 km), and the direct S itself is only ~0.2 coherent: scattered waves from scatterers beyond ~lambda*L/separation (~1 km) of the receiver also decorrelate, so 1-gamma is NOT the source-side weight; it only gives a loose upper limit w_S <~0.5-0.9. The kernel values (0.05-0.12 within 10 km of the source) are used for the conversion.

headline.error_calibration: bootstrap over stacks validated by pseudo-family splits (ratio ~0.9-1.1); placebo dates under-state noise at the M7 by ~2x (fewer post-event data); honest SE = max(bootstrap, placebo, permutation)
headline.candidate: family 27 post-M7 60-d transient deviation (see family_table_balanced.csv); not significant after multiplicity
headline.caveat_windows: coda windows end at the noise level, so window length depends on family amplitude and season; fixed time-after-S windows would be cleaner (not redone)
